entries.name: Anatomy
entries.summary: Crafted, highly detailed interactive isometric SVG figures that explain a technical idea as a real physical object (a rig, a dial, a plotter), with optional WebGL/3D effects, build scripts and visual-audit checks. Used by the research-videos module for mechanism explainer scenes; carried verbatim minus the 25 MB examples/ demos (see PROVENANCE.md in the skill).

entries.name: Diagram Design
entries.summary: Branded presentation diagrams (architecture, flowchart, sequence, ER, timeline, Sankey and 40+ more types) as HTML/SVG/PNG, with draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw import. OpenAR-adapted carry of the upstream skill; the recorded differences are in PROVENANCE.md inside the skill.

entries.name: Hallmark
entries.summary: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages: a default design flow plus three in-skill verbs the model performs when the user asks - audit (read the target, score it against the anti-pattern list, report only, never edit), redesign (re-visualize inside the existing implementation boundaries, preserving routes, copy intent and information architecture), and study (extract the design DNA from a screenshot or a URL the user supplies). These verbs are skill behaviors, not installed CLI commands. Inputs: a design brief, an existing page or component, or a screenshot/URL to study; output is HTML/CSS artifacts with locked design tokens, verified at 320/375/414/768 px. Carried verbatim from nutlope/hallmark at the pinned commit; only the skill directory (SKILL.md plus references) is carried, not the site/docs/demo.

entries.name: Human Writing
entries.summary: Write prose that reads as human: style control for fiction, forum posts and factual writing, with a check_prose.py revision pass. Carried verbatim from KKKKhazix/human-writing at the pinned commit; the carried file set only excludes VERSION, another runtime's agent config, and a generated distribution file.

entries.name: HyperFrames
entries.summary: Make, edit, animate and render videos with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video): the composition contract, storyboards, captions, motion, sound and review workflows, and the render contract. Pinned at the same upstream v0.8.202 tree the research-videos module pins for the CLI.

entries.name: HyperFrames CLI
entries.summary: The HyperFrames CLI by job: scaffold, check, look at frames, edit the timeline, preview, render locally or in the cloud, plus reading its JSON and recovering from build or render failures. Pinned at the upstream v0.8.202 tree, matching the host's bundled CLI version.

entries.name: HyperFrames Registry
entries.summary: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components (transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, maps, 3D) installed as editable source via hyperframes add/catalog, starting from a registry item instead of hand-building. Declares a dependency on the hyperframes skill, whose plugin rules it references.

entries.name: OfficeCLI Academic Paper
entries.summary: Academic-style .docx output: journal/conference/thesis chapters with APA, Chicago, IEEE or MLA citation style, numbered equations, cross-references, footnotes and bibliography. OpenAR-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill, published in lockstep with the compiled curated body at the same version (same version, same bytes): the upstream install commands and the manual-releases fallback are replaced with the pinned, checksum-verified host install path (an ora cli-adapter changeset the user approves and stages), the verify sentence points at list-adapters/run-cli-adapter, and an Apache-2.0 4(b) provenance notice is appended; everything else is upstream text.

entries.name: OfficeCLI Data Dashboard
entries.summary: Multi-element Excel dashboards from CSV or tabular input: Dashboard sheet on open, formula-driven KPI cards, charts, sparklines and conditional formatting. OpenAR-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill, published in lockstep with the compiled curated body at the same version (same version, same bytes): the upstream install commands and the manual-releases fallback are replaced with the pinned, checksum-verified host install path (an ora cli-adapter changeset the user approves and stages), the verify sentence points at list-adapters/run-cli-adapter, and an Apache-2.0 4(b) provenance notice is appended; everything else is upstream text.

entries.name: Research Design System
entries.summary: Design-reference selector for research outputs: a pinned, hash-verified index of 84 design-system analyses (DESIGN.md files) from VoltAgent/awesome-design-md, categorized as reference material - not skills, not brand themes, not brand assets. The user picks one material; the workflow fetches only that file at the pinned revision, verifies its sha256, caches it for offline use, distills the prose into a reviewable token candidate, and binds it to an output revision only after confirmation. Original OpenAR workflow; the analyses stay upstream and read-only.

entries.name: Scientific Figure Making
entries.summary: Publication-ready matplotlib figures for academic papers, slides, and reports in the figures4papers house style: grouped bars, trend lines, scatter, heatmaps, and multi-panel layouts, with print/vector export conventions (PDF/SVG/high-DPI) and parity with the figures4papers demo projects. Loads references progressively instead of up front. Use when finalizing or creating publication figures in matplotlib; not for interactive dashboards, web viz (Plotly/Altair/Bokeh), exploratory-only plots, dominant 3D or geographic mapping, or Illustrator/Figma-first infographics. Carried verbatim from ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers at the pinned commit; only the skill directory (SKILL.md plus references) is carried, not the figure_* demo projects. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only, attribution required.

entries.name: Web Design Guidelines

entries.name: Writing Guidelines
